{
  "analysis": "Key findings: The disk has a proper FAT16 filesystem with DOS, Windows 3.11, and many applications. However, the CPU is stuck at EIP=0x5f1 (real mode BIOS area) and not progressing — the VM appears hung during early boot. The task explicitly states QEMU 5.2.0 compatibility. Let me check the boot files, available machine types, and try older machine types before resorting to building QEMU 5.2.0.",
  "plan": "Read CONFIG.SYS and AUTOEXEC.BAT to understand the boot process. Check available QEMU machine types. Try an older machine type and CPU. If the VM is still stuck, we'll need to build/install QEMU 5.2.0.",
  "commands": [
    {
      "keystrokes": "echo "=== CONFIG.SYS ==="; mtype -i /app/isos/win311.img@@32256 ::CONFIG.SYS 2>/dev/null; echo "=== AUTOEXEC.BAT ==="; mtype -i /app/isos/win311.img@@32256 ::AUTOEXEC.BAT 2>/dev/null; echo "=== Machine types ==="; qemu-system-i386 -M help | head -20
",
      "duration": 0.1
    },
    {
      "keystrokes": "kill $(cat /tmp/qemu.pid) 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; rm -f /tmp/qemu-monitor.sock /tmp/qemu.pid
qemu-system-i386 \
  -M pc-i440fx-2.0 \
  -cpu 486 \
  -hda /app/isos/win311.img \
  -snapshot \
  -m 32 \
  -vga cirrus \
  -rtc base=localtime \
  -boot c \
  -vnc :1 \
  -monitor unix:/tmp/qemu-monitor.sock,server,nowait \
  -daemonize \
  -pidfile /tmp/qemu.pid
sleep 10
python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import socket, time, re
s = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
s.connect('/tmp/qemu-monitor.sock')
time.sleep(0.3)
s.recv(4096)
s.sendall(b'info registers\n')
time.sleep(0.3)
r1 = s.recv(8192).decode(errors='replace')
eip1 = re.search(r'EIP=([0-9a-f]+)', r1)
time.sleep(2)
s.sendall(b'info registers\n')
time.sleep(0.3)
r2 = s.recv(8192).decode(errors='replace')
eip2 = re.search(r'EIP=([0-9a-f]+)', r2)
print(f"EIP 1: {eip1.group(1) if eip1 else 'N/A'}, EIP 2: {eip2.group(1) if eip2 else 'N/A'}")
print(f"Progressing: {eip1 and eip2 and eip1.group(1) != eip2.group(1)}")
s.sendall(b'screendump /tmp/qemu-screen6.ppm\n')
time.sleep(0.5)
s.recv(4096)
s.close()
PYEOF
python3 -c "
with open('/tmp/qemu-screen6.ppm','rb') as f:
    f.readline(); dims = f.readline().strip(); f.readline(); data = f.read()
    w, h = map(int, dims.split())
    non_black = sum(1 for i in range(0, len(data), 3) if data[i] > 30 or data[i+1] > 30 or data[i+2] > 30)
    print(f'Dimensions: {w}x{h}, Non-black: {non_black} ({100*non_black/(w*h):.1f}%)')
"
",
      "duration": 15.0
    }
  ]
}
